Is Birdie just another booking tool?

No. Birdie is purpose-built for golf simulator venues — hourly bays, group bookings, weekday pricing, memberships, and 24/7 door access — with a revenue layer that shows you where to grow. Generic schedulers do none of that.
You go live within 24 hours of signing. We configure your bays, pricing, memberships, and add-ons for you — no developers, no migration headaches, no downtime.
Do I need technical experience to set up Birdie?
No. We handle all the setup. You book a walkthrough, we configure the system, and your booking flow goes live.
